checks.name: Each player is told their own controls: keys, a gamepad or touch, on the left or right of a shared screen, or anywhere on the screen when they play alone with a companion

Drag on the right of the screen to walk to the gold ring by the sofa, then tap Act .
pad: Walk with the left stick to the blue ring by the sofa, then press A .
Walk with the left stick to the gold ring by the sofa, then press A .
key: Walk with W A S D to the blue ring by the sofa, then press E .
Walk with the arrow keys to the gold ring by the sofa, then press Enter .
